reviews.text: Excellent professionals

I have nothing good to say about this clinic. I took my puppy there for her vaccinations and they ordered a bunch of tests for her. Up to that point, I accepted it. When I went for the first test, an ultrasound with the poor thing sedated, I left her there thinking everything would be fine since she had already had others done elsewhere and there hadn't been any problems. When I went back to pick her up, an hour later, they told me she was being washed because she had soiled herself. I asked how it had happened and they told me she had tried to bite and had been very aggressive. I was very surprised, but only after a few days did I see what they had done to her. My dog ​​never let me touch her again, she became aggressive, which she never was before, and at the moment, after consulting another veterinarian, she is taking sedatives daily because she is 15 years old, and I'm afraid something worse might happen. It all started in November 2025, and so far my little pet hasn't improved, and to be groomed, she has to take a large dose of sedation, and even then... I have no words to describe that clinic. I can only say that they want to make money with all kinds of exams and have no respect or patience for animals. I will never go back there, and I am very worried because I don't know what they did to my girl, who is even afraid of me.
This type of person should go plant potatoes instead of pretending to be animal caregivers.

I have to speak up.
About the person who just answered the phone, my dog ​​needed to be seen today...because his front paws are inflamed, and they didn't even give me the opportunity...to see another clinic, only for tomorrow...and they didn't even give me the opportunity to consider it an emergency.
"SO, THAT'S IT...THANK YOU AND EXCUSE ME"
A complete lack of common sense...
And a complete lack of empathy.
Impeccable service, super friendly staff.

We truly cannot thank this veterinary clinic enough.
We were traveling through Lisbon from Germany and suddenly needed a vet because our dog had been suffering from severe diarrhea and vomiting since the day before. We were extremely worried and walked into the clinic without an appointment and they immediately took us in and treated him.
What impressed us most was that from the very first moment, the animal truly came first here. Nobody started by talking about costs or paperwork, they simply helped right away. Even though the clinic was actually about to close, we were welcomed with incredible kindness, understanding, and professionalism. The veterinarian was absolutely wonderful. She immediately noticed how nervous our dog was and treated him with so much patience, calmness, and compassion. At the same time, she took a lot of time for us as owners as well. Everything was explained clearly: what examinations would be done, which medications were recommended, and why. She asked many questions, listened carefully, and made us feel taken seriously the entire time. We honestly rarely felt so well cared for anywhere else. We were prescribed three medications, all of which were explained to us in detail, and they even offered us to come back the next day anytime if we felt unsure or if his condition did not improve. They also gladly provided us with an invoice for our pet insurance upon request. This clinic was truly worth gold to us in that moment. You can genuinely feel that the people here do their job out of real love for animals. Experiencing this level of kindness, professionalism, and humanity is something very special. Absolute 5 stars, honestly, they deserve even more. Thank you so, so much for your help, your patience, and your care!
Very friendly and efficient ☺️

I was left with a terrible feeling and a grieving soul because of the veterinarian who prescribed doxybactin for my cat. She could have prescribed another, weaker antibiotic for the infection, but the doxybactin caused pneumonia, and that's why my cat...died.

A clinic with several experienced, empathetic, and very friendly professionals. I have been a client of the Vet Planet clinic since 2015/2016, and everyone who took care of my little Maltese was spectacular. I always had confidence in the veterinarians, nurses, and assistants. I am deeply grateful for everything they did for him and for all the help they gave me.
It is a clinic that treats our little ones as if they were their own and with great care.
Many thanks to all the professionals at this clinic in particular, but also to all the other professionals at the other clinics in the Vet Planet group.

Excellent clinic! We went for a consultation and they wouldn't let us leave until everything was finished. The vet was simply wonderful! She answered all our questions and did everything we needed, despite our dog's aggressive behavior. Thank you so much! 🙏🏻 …

My dog ​​has been receiving care at this clinic since she was a puppy, and Dr. Catarina and Dr. Sara are simply exemplary. Caring, attentive, and efficient, they have always treated us with the utmost care. It's important to remember that it's a clinic, not an emergency hospital, so we have to make appointments depending on their availability, but even so, we have always been very well received by the team.

We've been clients of the clinic for 7 years and I recommend it without hesitation. The staff's attention is fantastic, from the receptionists to the veterinarians. Carlos Gustavo thanks you for your kindness. ❤️

I came on Sunday with my dog ​​and, in addition to receiving excellent service, my dog ​​left with the "problem solved" feeling.

Friendly service and everything else! 5 stars

I've tried several veterinarians in the region over the past 12 years, and I can say with absolute certainty that this was one of the best services I've ever received. And at great prices. Professionalism, care, and genuine attention to the animals—I recommend them without hesitation.

I had a wonderful experience at this clinic. Everyone who attended to me was kind and attentive. The doctor who saw my cat, who was very sick, was extremely helpful and quick in what needed to be done, giving me all the explanations and alternatives available to me. The other doctors who treated my cat were equally attentive, empathetic, and extremely helpful. After hospitalization and medication, my cat returned home in a few days completely different from the worrying state she was in when we arrived at the clinic. I am very happy with all the attention, care, and affection they gave my Morganinha.
Beautiful humans running this centre. Very pleasant experience. Thank you everyone.

I would like to publicly commend the VetPlanet clinic in Arroios and its entire team. We first encountered the clinic in 2016 when Baltazar came to live in Lisbon. Since then, we have always received excellent care, not only for Baltazar but also for Boris. From 2016 until now, several veterinarians have cared for Baltazar, from Dr. Mónica to, more recently, Dr. Catarina. The entire team has always been characterized by professionalism. More recently, this week, unfortunately, Baltazar fell ill. And I wanted to publicly highlight the swift way in which the clinical staff referred Baltazar for more specialized hospital care. But above all, I want to emphasize the enormous empathy, cordiality, and kindness with which they have accompanied the entire process. From administrative staff, nurses, assistants, and doctors. Thank you all. Dr. Raquel, Dr. Catarina, and especially Dr. Sara, who was tireless yesterday in providing us with support, not only clinical concepts but also emotional support. Thank you all. Well done. And many congratulations on your competence and, above all, your care.
Tiago Bernardes
Because of this clinic's incompetence, I will stop using all the clinics in this group. Stay away.

We took our pet to Dr. Ana Marta Amorim in the ophthalmology department. The doctor was excellent in her care and guidance. The team at the Arroios clinic deserves praise; they treat our pets with so much love and affection. I highly recommend them.
The doctor is awful, unpleasant, only cares about making money, and doesn't know how to treat animals. I'm not going to that clinic anymore because of him!

I have a cat whose vaccinations and microchipping have always been impeccable, but now that I needed a consultation because she wasn't eating, I was told there were no appointments available until 3 days from now, and that if she couldn't eat, I should go to the veterinary hospital!
Very unprofessional and they are trying to sell as much as possible medicine
